about_the_game:
Fields of History: The Great War – Feature List

• A 3D Realistic World Map featuring more than 10,000 provinces, accurately representing the geographical, topographical, and meteorological conditions of the early 20th century.

• A Deep Political System that authentically depicts the geopolitical landscape of the 1910s, with all major historical leaders faithfully represented.

• Administrative Laws and Multiple Levels of Autonomy that change the way you play—whether you lead an empire, a sovereign nation, or a semi-independent state.

• Historical Events, National Decisions, and Decrees that present you with pivotal choices—each with potential repercussions for your nation and its neighbours.

• Over 250 Technologies to research and more than 300 Military Units and Equipment Types to develop, deploy, and master.

• Espionage and Covert Operations: steal technologies, conduct sabotage missions, infiltrate enemy warehouses, or incite revolts to destabilise rival powers.

• A Personalised Production System that lets you manage the output of weapons, supplies, and food for both your armies and your civilian population. Neglecting your people may lead to discontent and long-term instability.

• Strategic Supply Lines that must be developed and maintained to ensure your forces are properly equipped and capable of enduring the hardships of war.

• Command and Organisation: structure your Corps, Armies, Fleets, and Air Squadrons by appointing capable officers to key positions for maximum efficiency.

• Encirclement and Prisoners of War: surround enemy divisions, capture POWs, and employ them as a labour force within your industries.

• Chemical Warfare and Strategic Bombardments: unleash gas attacks or bombard your enemies from land, sea, and air to turn the tide of battle.

• A Dynamic Global Economy that evolves with wartime needs—allowing you to buy and sell raw materials to support your civilian and military industries.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 64 Bit or Windows® 11 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-3450 or equivalent (AVX support required)
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia® GeForce™ GTX 660 (2GB) or equivalent
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 10 64 Bit or Windows® 11 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-6500 or AMD® Ryzen™ 3 2200G (AVX support required)
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia® GeForce™ GTX 1660 (6GB) or equivalent
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: Fields of History is a real-time Grand Strategy game about the First World War. Choose a country and manage the political, economic, technological and military aspects. Lead your Nation through the Great War to victory. Impose your vision by rewriting History, it's up to you!
supported_languages:
English*, French
*languages with full audio support
